notes.title: New lands Update
notes.content:
[h1]New Jungle Biome [/h1]
We are adding a new Jungle biome into the game. This is a new starting biome. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41100770/1658a7c598d0ec1abecde15ba5e0356224ff8abd.png[/img]
[b]It contains 5 new tiles:[/b]
[list]
[*]Jungle
[*]Jungle berries
[*]Jungle relic
[*]Jungle bamboo
[*]Jungle trees
[/list]
[b]3 new buildings:[/b]
[list]
[*]Jungle Monument
[*]Lost temple
[*]Tribe house
[/list]
[b]And new spell:[/b]
[list]
[*]Jungle potion
[/list]
[h1]New Arid Valley Biome [/h1]
The second biome we are adding to the game is Arid Valley. It will unlock after Artic.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41100770/30662c72deb02f71eef23d8ca3056765b49448a4.png[/img]
[b]It contains 8 new tiles:[/b]
[list]
[*]Arid Valley
[*]Arid Valley fossil
[*]Arid Valley rocks
[*]Arid Valley crystal ore
[*]Arid Valley Relic
[*]Arid Plateau
[*]Arid Plateau with rocks
[*]Arid Plateau with crystal ore
[/list]
[b]4 new Buildings:[/b]
[list]
[*]Arid Valley monument
[*]Crystal cave
[*]Ruins
[*]Hermit house
[/list]
[b]And new Spell:[/b]
[list]
[*]Arid Valley potion
[/list]

We are also adding a new achievement - Greatest Explorer. Reach Arid Valley to unlock it.

[b]Balance changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Outpost now gives 4 coins instead of 2
[*]Lesser purge potion no more has radius (it clears single block)
[*]Purge potion now has radius 1 instead of 2
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]"Farmer" achivement now counts properly
[*]Coin circle now works on 1st unlock
[*]Cards preview no longer works in photo mode.
[*]Red preview material now removes properly, when switching to Brush or Rotate modes. 
[/list]
